claims.statement: Indra is the supreme Vedic god and a major deity in Hinduism, king of the devas and Heaven; he is associated with the sky, lightning, weather, thunder, sovereignty, power, kingship, truth, fertility, virtue, storms, rains, river flows, and war.
claims.statement_id: Indra adalah dewa Weda tertinggi dan dewa utama dalam Hinduisme, raja para deva dan Surga; ia dikaitkan dengan langit, petir, cuaca, guntur, kedaulatan, kekuasaan, kerajaan, kebenaran, kesuburan, kebajikan, badai, hujan, aliran sungai, dan perang.
claims.quote: is the supreme Vedic god and a major deity in Hinduism who is the king of the devas and Heaven (Known as Svar in Vedism and later Svarga in Hinduism). He is associated with the sky, lightning, weather, thunder, sovereignty, power, kingship, truth, fertility, virtue, storms, rains, river flows, and war.

claims.statement: Indra is often depicted with a vajra thunderbolt.
claims.statement_id: Indra sering digambarkan memegang vajra.
claims.quote: Indra is frequently portrayed wielding a thunderbolt (vajra) but he may also carry the chakra discus

claims.statement: Indra is often shown riding the white elephant Airavata.
claims.statement_id: Indra sering digambarkan menaiki gajah putih Airavata.
claims.quote: He is often shown riding his white elephant Airāvata

claims.statement: Indra killed Vritra, who blocked rivers and caused drought.
claims.statement_id: Indra membunuh Vritra yang menghalangi sungai dan menyebabkan kekeringan.
claims.quote: these tremendous coils were blocking up the rivers and streams and causing a great drought. So horrifying was Vritra that none of the gods dared intervene and it was only Indra who found the courage, fortified with soma, to slay the beast with one of his thunderbolts.

claims.statement: Indra was important in Vedic religion and later in Hindu and Buddhist traditions.
claims.statement_id: Indra penting dalam agama Weda dan kemudian tampil dalam Hinduisme serta Buddhisme.
claims.quote: Indra was the most important god in the Vedic religion and he later became a major figure in Hinduism and an important deity in Buddhism

claims.statement: Indra is known as Sakra in Buddhism.
claims.statement_id: Indra dikenal sebagai Sakra dalam Buddhisme.
claims.quote: Indra is known as Sakra in Buddhism and he rules the 33 gods.

claims.statement: Depictions of Vajrapani adopted the vajra scepter associated with Indra.
claims.statement_id: Penggambaran Vajrapani memakai tongkat vajra yang dikaitkan dengan Indra.
claims.quote: appropriated the lighting-bolt scepter (Skt: vajra) of Indra, the Vedic storm god, and repurposed it.

claims.statement: According to the Vishnu Purana, Indra is the title borne by the king of the gods, which changes every Manvantara; each Manvantara has its own Indra, and the Indra of the current Manvantara is called Purandhara.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Vishnu Purana, Indra adalah gelar yang disandang raja para dewa dan berganti setiap Manvantara; setiap Manvantara punya Indra sendiri, dan Indra pada Manvantara sekarang disebut Purandhara.
claims.quote: According to the Vishnu Purana, Indra is the title borne by the king of the gods, which changes every Manvantara – a cyclic period of time in Hindu cosmology. Each Manvantara has its own Indra and the Indra of the current Manvantara is called Purandhara.

claims.statement: Indra is the most frequently mentioned deity in the Rigveda.
claims.statement_id: Indra adalah dewa yang paling sering disebut dalam Rigveda.
claims.quote: Indra is the most frequently mentioned deity in the Rigveda.

claims.statement: Indra destroys Vritra and his "deceiving forces", and thereby brings rain and sunshine as the saviour of mankind.
claims.statement_id: Indra menghancurkan Vritra dan "kekuatan penipunya", dan dengan itu membawa hujan dan sinar matahari sebagai penyelamat umat manusia.
claims.quote: Indra destroys Vritra and his "deceiving forces", and thereby brings rain and sunshine as the saviour of mankind.

claims.statement: Indra is the chief god of the Ṛgveda; more than a quarter of the hymns in the collection are addressed to him, and they emphasize his heroic deeds.
claims.statement_id: Indra adalah dewa utama Ṛgveda; lebih dari seperempat himne dalam kumpulan itu ditujukan kepadanya, dan himne-himne itu menekankan perbuatan kepahlawanannya.
claims.quote: But the hymns to Indra, who is after all the chief god of the Ṛgveda (more than a quarter of the hymns in the collection are addressed to him), emphasize his heroic deeds.

claims.statement: Indra wields the thunderbolt, drinks the ambrosial soma to excess, bestows fertility upon human women (often by sleeping with them himself), and leads his band of Maruts, martial storm gods, to victory for the conquering Indo-Aryans.
claims.statement_id: Indra menggenggam petir, minum soma hingga berlebihan, memberi kesuburan kepada perempuan manusia (sering dengan tidur bersama mereka), dan memimpin Marut, dewa badai prajurit, meraih kemenangan bagi bangsa Indo-Arya penakluk.
claims.quote: He wields the thunderbolt, drinks the ambrosial soma to excess, bestows fertility upon human women (often by sleeping with them himself), and leads his band of Maruts, martial storm gods, to win victory for the conquering Indo-Aryans.

claims.statement: The worship of Indra, king of the gods, warrior of the gods, and god of rain, begins properly in the Ṛgveda, circa 1200 bce.
claims.statement_id: Pemujaan Indra, raja dewa, pejuang para dewa, dan dewa hujan, dimulai dengan sebenarnya dalam Ṛgveda, sekitar 1200 SM.
claims.quote: the worship of the god Indra, king of the gods, warrior of the gods, god of rain, begins properly in the Ṛgveda, circa 1200 bce

claims.statement: In the Ṛgveda, Indra's birth is unnatural: kept against his will inside his mother's womb for many years, he bursts forth out of her side and kills his own father.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Ṛgveda, kelahiran Indra tidak wajar: ia ditahan di rahim ibunya selama bertahun-tahun, lalu keluar dari sisinya dan membunuh ayahnya sendiri.
claims.quote: Kept against his will inside his mother's womb for many years, he bursts forth out of her side and kills his own father

claims.statement: Indra is said to have created the universe by propping apart heaven and earth, finding the sun, and freeing the cows that had been penned up in a cave.
claims.statement_id: Indra dikatakan menciptakan alam semesta dengan menyangga langit dan bumi agar terpisah, menemukan matahari, dan membebaskan sapi-sapi yang dikurung dalam gua.
claims.quote: He is said to have created the universe by propping apart heaven and earth ... and to have freed the cows that had been penned up in a cave

claims.statement: Indra, in the shape of a falcon or riding on a falcon, brought the soma plant down from heaven, where demons had guarded it, to earth, where it became accessible to humans.
claims.statement_id: Indra, dalam wujud elang atau menunggang elang, membawa tanaman soma dari surga, tempat para iblis menjaganya, ke bumi sehingga dapat diakses manusia.
claims.quote: It was Indra who, in the shape of a falcon or riding on a falcon, brought down the soma plant from heaven, where it had been guarded by demons, to earth, where it became accessible to humans

claims.statement: Indra's principal function is to kill enemies: non-Aryan humans and demons, who are often conflated.
claims.statement_id: Fungsi utama Indra adalah membunuh musuh, yaitu manusia non-Arya dan iblis, yang sering dicampuradukkan.
claims.quote: But Indra's principal function is to kill enemies—non-Aryan humans and demons, who are often conflated.

claims.statement: As the supreme god of the kṣatriyas, the class of royal warriors, Indra is invoked as a destroyer of cities and armies and as the staunch ally of his generous worshipers; Maghavan, "the generous," is one of his most popular epithets.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai dewa tertinggi kaum kṣatriya, kelas prajurit kerajaan, Indra dipanggil sebagai penghancur kota dan pasukan serta sekutu setia para pemuja yang dermawan; Maghavan, "yang murah hati", adalah salah satu julukannya yang paling populer.
claims.quote: As the supreme god of the kṣatriyas or class of royal warriors, Indra is invoked as a destroyer of cities and destroyer of armies, as the staunch ally of his generous worshipers, to whom Indra is in turn equally generous (Maghavan, "the generous," is one of his most popular epithets)

claims.statement: Indra's reputation begins to decline in the Brāhmaṇas, about 900 bce, where his supremacy is preempted by Prajāpati, the primordial creator.
claims.statement_id: Reputasi Indra mulai menurun dalam Brāhmaṇa, sekitar 900 SM, ketika kedudukan tertingginya diambil alih Prajāpati, sang pencipta primordial.
claims.quote: Indra's reputation begins to decline in the Brāhmaṇas, about 900 bce, where his supremacy is preempted by Prajāpati, the primordial creator.

claims.statement: Indra still drinks the soma, but now becomes badly hungover and has to be restored to health by the worshiper; the killing of Vṛtra leaves him weakened and in need of purification.
claims.statement_id: Indra masih minum soma tetapi kini mabuk berat dan harus dipulihkan oleh pemuja; pembunuhan Vṛtra juga membuatnya lemah dan memerlukan pemurnian.
claims.quote: Indra still drinks the soma, but now he becomes badly hungover and has to be restored to health by the worshiper. Similarly, the killing of Vṛtra leaves Indra weakened and in need of purification.

claims.statement: In the epics, his notorious womanizing leads to Indra's castration when the sage Gautama catches him in bed with Ahalyā, the sage's wife, though his testicles are later replaced by those of a ram.
claims.statement_id: Dalam wiracarita, kegemarannya mengejar perempuan menyebabkan Indra dikebiri ketika resi Gautama memergokinya bersama Ahalyā, istri sang resi, meskipun buah zakarnya kemudian diganti dengan milik domba jantan.
claims.quote: His notorious womanizing leads, on one occasion (when the sage Gautama catches Indra in bed with Ahalyā, the sage's wife), to Indra's castration, though his testicles are later replaced by those of a ram

claims.statement: When Indra's excesses weaken him, he becomes vulnerable in battle; often he is overcome by demons and must enlist the aid of the now supreme sectarian gods, Śiva and Viṣṇu, to restore his throne.
claims.statement_id: Ketika kelebihan-kelebihannya melemahkannya, Indra menjadi rentan dalam pertempuran; ia sering dikalahkan iblis dan harus meminta bantuan Śiva dan Viṣṇu untuk memulihkan takhtanya.
claims.quote: When Indra's excesses weaken him, he becomes vulnerable in battle; often he is overcome by demons and must enlist the aid of the now supreme sectarian gods, Śiva and Viṣṇu, to restore his throne.

claims.statement: Indra is evidently a pre-Vedic god, invoked by Mitanni Aryans of northern Syria in their famous treaty with the Hittites about 1380 b.c.
claims.statement_id: Indra tampaknya dewa pra-Weda, yang dipanggil oleh bangsa Arya Mitanni di Suriah utara dalam perjanjian terkenal mereka dengan bangsa Het sekitar 1380 SM.
claims.quote: Indra is evidently a pre-Vedic god, invoked by Mitanni Aryans of northern Syria in their famous treaty with the Hittites about 1380 b.c.

claims.statement: When destroying demons or human foe, Indra wields his vajra, a thunderbolt-mace forged by another, and becomes a shape-changer.
claims.statement_id: Ketika membinasakan iblis atau musuh manusia, Indra menggunakan vajra, gada petir yang ditempa, dan menjadi pengubah wujud.
claims.quote: When destroying demons or human foe, Indra wields his vajra, a thunderbolt-mace forged by ... and becomes a shape-changer

claims.statement: Above all, he is Vritrahan (slayer of Vritra), an epithet cognate to ancient Iranian Verethraghna.
claims.statement_id: Terutama, ia adalah Vritrahan (pembunuh Vritra), julukan yang sekerabat dengan Verethraghna dalam bahasa Iran kuno.
claims.quote: Above all, he is Vritrahan (slayer of Vritra) an epithet cognate to ancient Iranian Verethraghna.

claims.statement: Chariot-driving Indra, said to have a hundred powers, is bearded and gigantic in size.
claims.statement_id: Indra yang mengendarai kereta, konon berkuasa seratus daya, digambarkan berjanggut dan bertubuh raksasa.
claims.quote: Chariot-driving Indra, said to have a hundred powers, is bearded and gigantic in size.

claims.statement: In Buddhism, Indra is typically portrayed as a guardian of the religion and the chief deity in the heaven of the thirty-three gods.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Buddhisme, Indra biasanya digambarkan sebagai penjaga agama dan dewa utama di surga tiga puluh tiga dewa.
claims.quote: He is typically portrayed as a guardian of the religion and the chief deity in the heaven of the thirty-three gods.

claims.statement: In some versions of the Buddha's life story, Indra receives the infant Buddha as he emerges from his mother's side and then bathes him.
claims.statement_id: Dalam sebagian versi kisah hidup Buddha, Indra menerima bayi Buddha ketika keluar dari sisi ibunya lalu memandikannya.
claims.quote: In some versions of the Buddha's life story, Indra receives the infant Buddha as he emerges from his mother's side and then bathes him.

claims.statement: In Myanmar (Burma), Indra is venerated at the end of the year as Thagya Min.
claims.statement_id: Di Myanmar (Burma), Indra dihormati pada akhir tahun sebagai Thagya Min.
claims.quote: He is venerated at the end of the year as Thagya Min in Myanmar (Burma).

claims.statement: The image of Indra's net, which stretches infinitely across the heavens, becomes important in the Mahāyāna tradition as a metaphor for the interconnectedness of all beings.
claims.statement_id: Citra jaring Indra, yang terbentang tak terhingga di langit, menjadi penting dalam tradisi Mahāyāna sebagai metafora keterkaitan semua makhluk.
claims.quote: The image of Indra's net, which stretches infinitely across the heavens, becomes important in the ... as a metaphor for the interconnectedness of all beings.

claims.statement: In the Hindu creation myth Indra was born (along with his brother Agni) from the mouth of the primordial god or giant Purusha.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitos penciptaan Hindu, Indra lahir (bersama saudaranya Agni) dari mulut dewa atau raksasa primordial Purusha.
claims.quote: In the Hindu creation myth Indra was born (along with his brother Agni) from the mouth of the primordial god or giant Purusha

claims.statement: Indra, seated on his throne within the storm clouds of the svarga or third heaven, is ruler of the clouds and skies alongside his wife Indrāni.
claims.statement_id: Indra duduk di takhtanya dalam awan badai di svarga atau surga ketiga sebagai penguasa awan dan langit bersama istrinya, Indrāni.
claims.quote: Indra, seated on his throne within the storm clouds of the svarga or third heaven is ruler of the clouds and skies alongside his wife Indrāni.

claims.statement: In Indian mythology the clouds are equated with divine cattle and the sound of thunder during storms is Indra fighting with the demons who are forever trying to steal these celestial cows.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi India, awan disamakan dengan ternak ilahi, dan suara guntur saat badai adalah Indra yang bertarung dengan iblis yang selalu berusaha mencuri sapi surgawi itu.
claims.quote: In Indian mythology the clouds are equated with divine cattle and the sound of thunder during storms is Indra fighting with the demons who are forever trying to steal these celestial cows.

claims.statement: Indra encompasses and controls the universe, balancing the earth in the palm of his hand and manipulating it according to his whim; he also created the rivers and streams by shaping the mountains and valleys with his sacred axe.
claims.statement_id: Indra mencakup dan mengendalikan alam semesta, menyeimbangkan bumi di telapak tangannya dan mengaturnya sesuka hati; ia juga menciptakan sungai dan aliran dengan membentuk gunung dan lembah menggunakan kapak sucinya.
claims.quote: Indra encompasses and controls the universe, balancing the earth in the palm of his hand and manipulating it according to his whim. He also created the rivers and streams by shaping the mountains and valleys with his sacred axe.

claims.statement: As king of the gods he is generally benevolent, generous to his worshippers, guaranteeing peace and prosperity and delivering beneficial rainstorms to end droughts.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai raja para dewa, Indra umumnya baik hati, murah hati kepada pemujanya, menjamin perdamaian dan kemakmuran, serta mendatangkan hujan badai yang menguntungkan untuk mengakhiri kekeringan.
claims.quote: as king of the gods he is generally benevolent, being generous to his worshippers, guaranteeing peace and prosperity and delivering beneficial rainstorms to end droughts.

claims.statement: Vala hid his prize in the depths of a mountain but was tracked down by Indra's servants the Maruts or Rudras (storm gods), then one thunderbolt from Indra was enough to split the mountain in two and release the herd, who were safely escorted back to the heavens.
claims.statement_id: Vala menyembunyikan hasil curiannya di dalam gunung, tetapi dilacak oleh para Marut (atau Rudra), pelayan Indra, lalu satu petir Indra cukup untuk membelah gunung dan melepaskan kawanan sapi yang dikawal pulang ke langit.
claims.quote: Vala cleverly hid his prize in the depths of a mountain but was tracked down by Indra's servants the Maruts or Rudras (storm gods), then, one thunderbolt from Indra was enough to split the mountain in two and release the herd who were safely escorted back to the heavens.

claims.statement: Indra is known for his fondness for the alcoholic elixir soma, which he does not always take in moderation, so that he sometimes suffers from its after-effects.
claims.statement_id: Indra dikenal gemar minum soma, minuman memabukkan, yang tidak selalu ia minum secukupnya sehingga kadang menderita efek sampingnya.
claims.quote: he is known for his fondness of the alcoholic elixir drink soma which he does not always take in moderation and so he sometimes suffers from its after-effects.

claims.statement: As a result of this episode he won great favour among the other great gods and one of Indra's surnames became Vritrahan, meaning the "slayer of Vritra".
claims.statement_id: Karena kisah itu, Indra mendapat restu besar dari dewa-dewa lain dan salah satu julukannya menjadi Vritrahan, "pembunuh Vritra".
claims.quote: As a result of this episode he won great favour among the other great gods and one of Indra's surnames became Vritrahan, meaning the 'slayer of Vritra'.

claims.statement: In the Sanskrit epic Mahabharata, Indra is the father of the hero Arjuna and manages to win the magic armour that would make his son invincible.
claims.statement_id: Dalam wiracarita Sanskerta Mahabharata, Indra adalah ayah pahlawan Arjuna dan berhasil memperoleh baju zirah ajaib yang membuat putranya tak terkalahkan.
claims.quote: In the Sanskrit epic Mahabharata, Indra is the father of the hero Arjuna and he manages to win the magic armour that would make his son invincible.

claims.statement: In the Cham religion of Vietnam he is also the god of thunder and rides a white elephant; in Chinese tradition he is identified with the god Ti-shi.
claims.statement_id: Dalam agama Cham di Vietnam, Indra juga dewa guntur dan menunggang gajah putih; dalam tradisi Tionghoa ia diidentikkan dengan dewa Ti-shi.
claims.quote: In the Cham religion of Vietnam he is also the god of thunder and rides a white elephant. In Chinese tradition he is identified with the god Ti-shi.

claims.statement: In Cambodian tradition he is known as Pah En, the god of the sky, and is considered to live atop Mt. Meru or Prah Sumer.
claims.statement_id: Dalam tradisi Kamboja, Indra dikenal sebagai Pah En, dewa langit, yang dianggap tinggal di puncak Gunung Meru atau Prah Sumer.
claims.quote: In Cambodian tradition he is known as Pah En the god of the sky and he is the most popular of the gods. He is considered to live atop Mt. Meru or Prah Sumer

claims.statement: The god is still worshipped today in the Rajasthan region of India in the festival of Inder Puja, which calls for rains to prevent the frequent droughts prevalent in this desert state.
claims.statement_id: Indra masih dipuja hingga kini di wilayah Rajasthan, India, dalam festival Inder Puja yang memohon hujan untuk mencegah kekeringan yang sering terjadi di negara bagian gurun itu.
claims.quote: the god is still worshipped today in the Rajasthan region of India in the festival of Inder Puja which calls for rains to prevent the frequent droughts prevalent in this desert state.

claims.statement: Besides the vajra, Indra may carry the chakra discus, an ankusa or elephant goad, and an axe, the tanka.
claims.statement_id: Selain vajra, Indra dapat membawa cakram chakra, ankusa (kait gajah), dan kapak yang disebut tanka.
claims.quote: but he may also carry the chakra discus, an ankusa or elephant goad and an axe, the tanka.

claims.statement: In later Buddhism the god's thunderbolt becomes a diamond sceptre, the Vajrayana.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Buddhisme belakangan, petir sang dewa menjadi tongkat kerajaan berlian, Vajrayana.
claims.quote: In later Buddhism the god's thunderbolt becomes a diamond sceptre, the Vajrayana.

claims.statement: In Rigveda 1.32 the poet declares the manly deeds of Indra, the Thunder-wielder: he slew the Dragon, disclosed the waters, and cleft the channels of the mountain torrents.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Ṛgveda 1.32, penyair menyatakan perbuatan jantan Indra, sang pemegang petir: ia membunuh Naga, membuka perairan, dan membelah saluran arus gunung.
claims.quote: I will declare the manly deeds of Indra, the first that he achieved, the Thunder-wielder. He slew the Dragon, then disclosed the waters, and cleft the channels of the mountain torrents.

claims.statement: Indra slew the Dragon lying on the mountain; his heavenly bolt of thunder was fashioned by Tvashṭar.
claims.statement_id: Indra membunuh Naga yang berbaring di gunung; petir surgawinya ditempa oleh Tvashṭar.
claims.quote: He slew the Dragon lying on the mountain: his heavenly bolt of thunder Tvashṭar fashioned.

claims.statement: Impetuous as a bull, Indra chose the Soma and drank the juices in three sacred beakers; Maghavan grasped the thunder for his weapon and smote to death the firstborn of the dragons.
claims.statement_id: Bagaikan banteng yang menggebu, Indra memilih Soma dan meminum sarinya dalam tiga cawan suci; Maghavan menggenggam petir sebagai senjata dan menghantam mati anak sulung para naga.
claims.quote: Impetuous as a bull, he chose the Soma, and in three sacred beakers drank the juices. Maghavan grasped the thunder for his weapon, and smote to death this firstborn of the dragons.

claims.statement: Indra with his own great and deadly thunder smote into pieces Vṛitra, worst of Vṛitras.
claims.statement_id: Indra dengan petirnya yang dahsyat dan mematikan menghancurkan Vṛitra, yang terburuk di antara para Vṛitra.
claims.quote: Indra with his own great and deadly thunder smote into pieces Vṛitra, worst of Vṛitras.

claims.statement: When he had smitten Vṛitra, Indra opened the cave wherein the floods had been imprisoned.
claims.statement_id: Setelah menghantam Vṛitra, Indra membuka gua tempat banjir air dipenjara.
claims.quote: But he, when he had smitten Vṛitra, opened the cave wherein the floods had been imprisoned.

claims.statement: Indra is King of all that moves and moves not, of creatures tame and horned, the Thunder-wielder.
claims.statement_id: Indra adalah Raja segala yang bergerak dan tak bergerak, makhluk jinak dan bertanduk, sang pemegang petir.
claims.quote: Indra is King of all that moves and moves not, of creatures tame and horned, the Thunder-wielder.

claims.statement: According to a footnote quoting Wilson, Vṛitra (sometimes named Ahi) is nothing more than the accumulation of vapour shut up in a cloud, and Indra with his thunderbolt divides the mass so that rain descends upon the earth.
claims.statement_id: Menurut catatan kaki yang mengutip Wilson, Vṛitra (kadang disebut Ahi) hanyalah akumulasi uap yang terkumpul dalam awan, dan Indra dengan petirnya membelah massa itu sehingga hujan turun ke bumi.
claims.quote: Vṛitra, sometimes also named Ahi, is nothing more than the accumulation of vapour, condensed or figuratively shut up in, or obstructed by, a cloud. Indra, with his thunderbolt, or atmospheric or electrical influence, divides the aggregated mass, and vent is given to the rain which then descends upon the earth.

claims.statement: In Rigveda 2.12, he who, just born, was chief God of lofty spirit and by power and might became the Gods' protector is named as Indra.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Ṛgveda 2.12, ia yang begitu lahir menjadi dewa utama berjiwa luhur dan dengan daya dan kekuatan menjadi pelindung para dewa disebut Indra.
claims.quote: just born, chief God of lofty spirit by power and might became the Gods' protector

claims.statement: Indra fixed fast and firm the earth that staggered, set at rest the agitated mountains, measured out the air's wide middle region, and gave the heaven support.
claims.statement_id: Indra mengokohkan bumi yang goyah, menenangkan gunung-gunung yang bergolak, mengukur ruang tengah udara, dan menopang langit.
claims.quote: He who fixed fast and firm the earth that staggered, and set at rest the agitated mountains, Who measured out the air's wide middle region and gave the heaven support

claims.statement: Indra slew the Dragon, freed the Seven Rivers, drove the kine forth from the cave of Vala, and begat the fire between two stones.
claims.statement_id: Indra membunuh Naga, membebaskan Tujuh Sungai, menggiring sapi keluar dari gua Vala, dan melahirkan api di antara dua batu.
claims.quote: Who slew the Dragon, freed the Seven Rivers, and drove the kine forth from the cave of Vala, Begat the fire between two stones, the spoiler in warriors' battle
